shared_elements: schematic rendering of body or facial features
symmetrical composition about a vertical axis
justification: Both are schematic anthropomorphic depictions organised symmetrically about a vertical axis  head with hair/brows, eyes and a bared row of teeth in A; an incised garment or torso with nested rectangular frames and small central motifs in B. Beyond the generic fact that each reduces a human subject to a few incised lines, they share no specific motif: A is a three-dimensional head with facial features, while B is a flat plaque whose content is a rectilinear framed panel with no face at all.
